issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode change from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent behavioral break.
issues.detail: Flipping the default changes who owns end-of-turn semantics for every caller relying on the prior default. The changelog files this under 'fixed' but it is a behavioral default change. Either keep EXTERNAL as default, gate behind explicit opt-in, or call it out loudly as a breaking change with a migration note.

issues.description: _enable_vad complects multiple concerns and its name no longer matches its semantics.
issues.detail: One boolean now governs frame emission, acceptance of external finalize, and a warning branch, with a confusing `elif not self._enable_vad` double-negative. Split into two named predicates derived from the mode enum (e.g. emits_vad_frames, accepts_external_finalize) and document the invariant so the next reader doesn't invert the predicate.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced but no import or definition is visible in the diff.
issues.detail: If the speechmatics SDK 0.0.99 added FIXED, the PR should show the import or version bump as evidence. Otherwise this raises AttributeError at construction time. Verify the enum exists on the installed SDK and surface the dependency change explicitly.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics call was moved but neither deleted nor restored.
issues.detail: The line migrated from after the interruption frame to before it with no functional effect. Either uncomment and own it, or delete it. Leaving dead, drifting commented code encodes an unresolved decision in source and pollutes future diffs.

issues.description: split_sentences plumbing is stringly-typed and double-written.
issues.detail: The field is forwarded via a hard-coded allowlist relying on hasattr, then overwritten by a dedicated speech_segment_config assignment. Adding a parameter requires editing two places and typos silently no-op. Drive the mapping from the InputParams schema and remove the redundant write.

issues.description: split_sentences coercion via `or False` collapses None and False, obscuring intent.
issues.detail: `emit_sentences=params.split_sentences or False` unconditionally writes SpeechSegmentConfig even when the user passed None, stomping any SDK default. Use `bool(params.split_sentences)` and only construct the config when the user explicitly set the value, or set a real default in the schema.

synthesis.summary: The patch is small but bundles three logically independent changes (frame-type switch to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, default mode flip to FIXED with a new enum value, and a split_sentences passthrough). The headline concern is the silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED, which flips who owns end-of-turn semantics for existing callers without a clear migration note. The `_enable_vad` predicate now complects emission, external-finalize acceptance, and a warning branch into one boolean whose name no longer matches its semantics — it should decompose into named predicates derived from the mode. Secondary cleanup: verify EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is actually imported from the upgraded SDK, resolve the drifting commented start_processing_metrics line, and tighten the stringly-typed split_sentences plumbing.
